title: Profile
description: Everything the user enters. Stored only in the browser (localStorage, plus optional export/import). Derived values (X/24, Amex card counts, 'ever had') are computed by the engine, never stored. Draft.

approvalCounts.description: How many copies of the card were approved in each window. The four windows do not overlap.

cardHistoryEntry.description: History for one catalog card. current and each approval window are entered independently (owner, 2026-09-22) and are not required to be consistent with each other; the engine reads both as separate facts.

marriott.description: Only for Marriott cards. The two windows shorter than the count buckets, for the Marriott eligibility matrix (the 24-month bonus test uses the bonus-date counts).

otherPersonalCards.description: Free-form counts for personal cards not named in the catalog. Only the last 24 months matter.

cards.description: Map of catalog card id to history entry. Cards not listed mean none. For Southwest and Marriott cards the approval counts mean the date the bonus was received; for every other card, the approval date.

otherPersonalByIssuer.description: 'Other [issuer] personal cards' lines inside each listed issuer section.

shutdownIssuers.description: Issuers that have shut this player down. Empty means none. Cards from these issuers are removed for this player.

wantsUnder524.description: Interested in getting under 5/24 (if over) or staying under 5/24 (if under).

hasBoaDepositAccount.description: Has an open Bank of America deposit account (BoA credit-card count limit: more than 6 in 12 months with one, more than 2 without).

hasAmexBusinessChecking.description: Has an Amex Business Checking account in their own name. Asked only if the player holds a Business Platinum. With one, Amex points cash out well.

willingToFormLlcForInk.description: Lives in a low-fee LLC state and is willing to form an LLC (with its own EIN, for a real business) to get around Chase's Ink lifetime limit. Asked only if an Ink card's bonus is otherwise blocked by that limit. A yes lifts the lifetime block for every Ink card (docs/rule-audit.md K7).

maxAnnualFee.description: Highest annual fee accepted on a single card in its first year: a card whose first-year fee is waived counts as $0. Null (left blank) means no limit.

spend3Months.description: Spend if all day-to-day non-housing expenses went on one card for 3 months.

items.description: A program id or group from programs.json, or 'cashback'.
A program id or group from programs.json.

targetPrograms.description: Optional. Programs the household is planning a specific redemption in. Cards that lead to them are ranked above the rest.
